what: Reference score 0-100 for a deep, calm, male broadcaster narrator (calibration project, 2026-10-26). Copy and retune the bands from YOUR casting brief; write the new rubric down BEFORE measuring, never after seeing the ranking.
gates_before_score: licence tier A first, B below A, X excluded
target sex by F0 band (here: median under 165 Hz) and not a voice the owner already rejected or banned

REF-QUALITY pass (after the edge fix) ranks above fail
